capabilities: Render mind maps from indented bullets and headings in mindmap code blocks
Configure per-map options such as direction, colors, fonts, and edge style
Mark nodes with tier symbols and compass bearings for map-like layouts
Draw cross-links and named edge labels between nodes
Pan, zoom, and refit maps with drag, double-click, and Ctrl-scroll
extras: Installed by manually copying three files (manifest.json, main.js, styles.css) into the plugins folder rather than through the community plugin store; the README says it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows nested lists only as plain text, so turning a hierarchy into a visual mind map inside a note normally means leaving the note or an external tool.
summary: Renders indented Markdown lists inside mindmap code blocks as pan-and-zoom mind maps, with tiers, a compass layout, and cross-links.
